name: Mod Menu
description: Menu on Tab: noclip, speedhack, auto bot, macro record/replay, safe mode.

mode.name: Bot mode
mode.description: Auto bot = plays cube/wave by itself. Record macro = record your run. Replay macro = plays the saved run.

legit.name: Mistakes level
legit.description: Auto bot only. 0 = perfect, 10 = human-like mistakes.

safe-mode.name: Safe mode
safe-mode.description: Blocks level completion if cheats were on during the attempt.
